# André Emiliano

> Senior Developer based in the United Kingdom, available for remote work.
> Builds native iOS, cross-platform mobile and full-stack web software.

Currently a Senior Developer at Calvium (since January 2024, remote), where he
ships SwiftUI features for the Met Office Weather app used by over 3 million
people, architects React Native applications for regulated healthcare
environments, and builds Nuxt, PrimeVue and TypeScript internal tooling for Rolls-Royce.

Founder and lead developer of FryAI (https://www.fryai.app), an LLM-powered
air fryer cooking assistant built in React Native and Expo, taken solo from
wireframes to the App Store.

Previously an iOS Developer at VML Enterprise Solutions (formerly NN4M) from
April 2022 to January 2024, shipping features across the River Island,
American Golf and Iceland Bonus Card retail iOS apps.

Education: MSc Software Development (Distinction) and BSc Computer Science
(First-Class Honours), both Coventry University.

Core skills: Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Vue, Nuxt,
PrimeVue, Tailwind, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Supabase, LLM integration, prompt
engineering, Playwright (end-to-end testing), Bun and Bun's test runner,
Cypress, CI/CD (Bitrise, Fastlane), WCAG accessibility, App Store deployment.
